summary: Re-ran the 4 suite failures in the sandbox: the builder test and the rain-shower puddle party failed again (reproducible); the flower gift and parade party passed on re-run (flaky). I did no new exploratory play, so the long day and the slide-past-solids change were not checked beyond the suite.

failures.what: After a publish the builder does not finish the build: Sprout is not the builder in the full suite run, and in an isolated re-run the new cairn never appeared after the build.
failures.steps: live_tests("After a publish Sprout carries") in the sandbox (tests/builder.jl): stop!/start! a plugin, try_publish!, wait for the build.
failures.expected: Sprout carries a crate to the site, works there, and the hidden new plots appear when it is done.
failures.actual: Suite run: builder is creature 8, not Sprout (Sprout was walking/fishing). Isolated re-run: 'check failed: the cairn did not appear after the build'. Possibly the new long day or the new player slide/clearance code in separation.jl changed this, or fishing/other goals pull Sprout away from :build.

failures.what: Rain shower puddle party is short of dancers: only 1 to 2 critters come to the puddle party.
failures.steps: live_tests("Rain shower"), tests/minigames.jl; failed in the suite (Hopscotch, Wibbles) and in the re-run (only Hopscotch).
failures.expected: Sprout splashing in the open brings all critters to a puddle party.
failures.actual: Only Hopscotch (and sometimes Wibbles) reach the :party role. This fails twice in a row, so it is not a one-off.

failures.what: Flaky: Flower gift: the giver says 'For you, Sprout!' where the test expected something else (gave nothing to say). It passed on re-run.
failures.steps: Run the full suite; the flower gift test fails there but passed alone.
failures.actual: Failed once in the suite (Gloop, partner 1, friend 3), passed alone.

failures.what: Flaky: Parade party in the full suite: no dance ring after walking the parade to the lantern, followers 0, Sprout not steered. It passed alone.
failures.steps: Run the full suite, then the test alone.
failures.expected: The three followers stay with Sprout and form a dance ring at the lantern.
failures.actual: In the suite followers had left the parade (they were on :dance/:pebble/:idle); alone it passed in 45 s. Likely state left over from the earlier failed tests.
